input.jobDescription: Handle accounts payable and receivable, process invoices and payments, perform bank reconciliations, chase overdue payments, assist with GST filing and month-end closing, maintain records in accounting software.

result.role_summary: You keep the money side of the business accurate: invoices in, payments out, and books that balance. A lot of the repetitive matching and keying will be done by software, so your growing value is in checking, explaining and spotting what doesn't look right.

tasks.explanation: Accounting software can now read invoices from email or photos and fill in the details automatically. You'll handle the ones it isn't sure about.
Most transactions can be matched to bank records automatically. Your job becomes investigating the few that don't match.
Reminder emails for overdue invoices can be scheduled and sent by the system on fixed dates.
AI can pull together reports and flag unusual movements, but you still need to understand and explain the numbers.
tasks.ai_tool_idea: Paste a summary of this month's expenses (with no names or account numbers) into AI and ask it to point out anything that changed a lot from last month.

tasks.explanation: Software can calculate GST figures, but checking that items are classified correctly takes care and an understanding of the rules.
tasks.ai_tool_idea: Ask an AI assistant to explain a GST rule you are unsure about in simple terms, then confirm it against official guidance before acting.

tasks.explanation: AI can help you draft clear explanations of claims policies or payment timelines, making you the go-to person for help.
tasks.ai_tool_idea: Ask AI: "Explain our 30-day payment terms to a new sales colleague in three friendly sentences." Then adjust for your company.

tasks.task: Following up on difficult overdue accounts
tasks.explanation: When a long-time customer is struggling to pay, a thoughtful phone call that keeps the relationship intact needs a human touch.
Tools can flag odd entries, but deciding whether something is a simple mistake or a real concern needs your judgement and honesty.

skills_to_build.skill: Using automation features in accounting software
skills_to_build.why: Knowing your software's auto-matching and invoice-reading features well means you set them up right and fix them when they go wrong.
Pivot tables and simple formulas help you understand the numbers behind the reports AI produces.
Managers need someone who can say what the figures mean. That's a skill that grows in value as reports become automatic.
With more automation, someone needs to make sure the right checks and approvals are still in place.

plan_30_days.focus: Learn what your software can automate
actions: Watch the official tutorial videos for your accounting software's automation or AI features.
List the three tasks that take most of your week.
With your supervisor's OK, switch on one feature such as bank-feed matching and check its results carefully for a week.
Note how many items it matched correctly and how many you had to fix.
Use AI to help you write a three-sentence summary of last month's expenses, then check every figure yourself.
Share the summary with your supervisor and ask for feedback.
Look up subsidised courses in digital accounting or data analysis for Singapore workers, and shortlist one.
Write down one process you'd like to improve next quarter and why.

result.encouragement: Accuracy and trust are the heart of accounting, and AI makes careful people like you even more valuable.
